metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully center-aligned the heading 'Guidelines on drawing up a Constitution' using triple-click to select + Ctrl+E to center-align in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select paragraph text, apply keyboard shortcuts for text formatting (Ctrl+E for center, Ctrl+I for italic) in LibreOffice Writer.
metadata.explanation: Chains the original center-alignment goal with an additional italic formatting requirement. Getter reads the saved docx and checks paragraph[0] alignment and italic status. Initial state fails (not centered, not italic). Score: 0.5 for centered + 0.5 for italic.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the saved docx and parses doc.paragraphs[0] as the heading, consistent with the document structure.
para.alignment == WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER correctly verifies center alignment as direct paragraph formatting applied via Ctrl+E.
Metric awards partial credit (0.5 + 0.5) matching the scoring breakdown; both sub-goals are checked independently.
postconfig saves the file before evaluation, ensuring the final state is captured.
Initial state (not centered, not italic) will correctly fail, providing negative-control resistance.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using all(run.italic is True for run in para.runs) instead of any(...) to strictly verify the entire heading is italic rather than just one run.
If para.alignment may be None when alignment is inherited from paragraph style, consider also checking the paragraph style's alignment as a fallback.
